## Summary

Ghaith Mefteh has 3+ years of production experience and works across the entire
request path rather than a single layer: the screen in the browser, the app on the
phone, the API behind them, and the database under that. He currently leads four
engineers on a production marketplace at AzertyUI, covering architecture, code review
standards and release priorities, and is designing the backend for AzertyUI's next
in-house product.

He is open to remote full-time engineering roles and freelance projects, anywhere —
full-stack, backend-leaning, or mobile.

## Technical skills

- Backend: Symfony, PHP, Doctrine ORM, FastAPI, Python, REST API design, WebSockets
- Databases: MySQL, MongoDB — query optimization, caching, migrations
- Frontend: React, Angular, TypeScript
- Mobile: Flutter, Dart — published to both the Apple App Store and Google Play,
  including owning iOS release engineering in Xcode (signing certificates,
  provisioning profiles, App Store Connect, TestFlight through to production)
- Infrastructure and delivery: AWS, Docker, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, PHPUnit
- Practices: performance optimization, test suites, CI/CD, code review, technical leadership
- Design-to-code: translating Figma designs screen by screen into Flutter widgets

## Measured results

- Search page load time on a live marketplace: reduced from 20–50 seconds to 4–6 seconds
- Test suite: built from zero to 390+ tests
- Image bandwidth: reduced by approximately 60% via on-demand WebP and multi-size caching
- Flutter app: past 2,000 downloads across iOS and Android

## Production projects

### chalet-montagne.com — Full-stack engineer, AzertyUI, 2024–present
French mountain-rental marketplace. Full rebuild on Symfony: legacy data and business
logic migrated with functional parity, then the search and listing engine rewritten
with caching, query optimization and parallelized data processing. Also built the
reservation pipeline end to end — dynamic seasonal pricing, two-way iCal sync with
external booking channels, payment integration, and the CI/CD plus PHPUnit suite
enabling frequent, safe production releases.
Stack: Symfony, Doctrine, MySQL, PHPUnit, GitLab CI.
Live at https://www.chalet-montagne.com/

### SOC Rugby — Mobile engineer, AzertyUI, 2024
Official app of a French rugby club. Live match results, rankings, WebSocket chat and
push notifications. Built in Flutter, published to the App Store and Google Play, past
2,000 downloads. Started from a Figma design translated screen by screen into clean
Dart/Flutter widgets. Owned the iOS release end to end in Xcode.
Stack: Flutter, Dart, Xcode, iOS certificates, WebSockets, push notifications.

### SmartCare — Full-stack engineer, Hope Horizon Health & Care, 2023–2024
Healthcare platform for Tunisia: appointment booking, ambulance dispatch, push
notifications, Google Maps integration. Designed and shipped solo across the stack —
Flutter app on Google Play, ReactJS web at smartcare.tn, FastAPI backend on MongoDB,
deployed to AWS with GitHub Actions. In production for real patients and doctors.
Stack: Flutter, Dart, FastAPI, MongoDB, ReactJS, AWS.

### Forklift-mounted warehouse terminal — Engineering internship, L-Mobile, 2024
Tablets mounted on forklifts giving warehouse operators live inventory and logistics
data while moving. Five warehouse-management modules integrating Microsoft Dynamics
365 Business Central over C#/.NET and REST.
Stack: C#/.NET, D365 Business Central, REST.

## Side projects

- Sakia: Remote control for farm water pumps — an Expo app talking MQTT to an ESP32
  in the field, in Arabic, French and English.
- Pulse: An AI writing companion for LinkedIn that drafts posts in the user's own
  voice, mobile-first, with its own design system.
- Conforma: Audits documents against legal obligations using rule-based checks backed
  by a structured catalog of legal requirements.
